duties.name: Mac stays usable
duties.ownerWords:
look it's you and ops guys responsibility that this machine is usable.

you -harness side of bullshit, ops guy -app side of bullshit fixing monitoring

setup a 60min cadence duty
duties.goal: The Mac stays usable every minute: memory pressure stays under critical, swapouts stay under 6,000 a second, and kernel_task stays under one core, read from ops guy's pressure feed. On the harness side no working session sits quiet over 30 min and no queued turn waits over 706 s. The Prime worker footprint is a detail line with no target.
